_comment: Tag -> world-coordinate map for localisation, filled with the INVENTED example flat (not a real home): a 900 x 600 cm rectangle, x -400..500, y -100..500. Hallway x -50..50 along +Y (front door at its south end, y=-100); west of it the kitchen (y -100..150) and the living room (y 150..500, balcony door in its north wall); east of it the bathroom (y -100..150, FORBIDDEN: step-down threshold) and the bedroom (y 150..500). Origin (0,0) = the dock spot in the hallway, 100 cm in from the front door. +X = east/right, +Y = north/along the hallway, unit cm. yaw = facing direction of the tag's face in degrees, CCW from the +X axis. Replace every value with your own measurements; save the result on the robot as tags_coords.json.
